reviews.decision: This public NgZone import annotates the unchanged second constructor argument and is consumed only by the complete historical ngAfterViewInit callback. All historical class members, base initialization, ID counter, clamp helper, actual owned color mixin and HTML are independently exact against authenticated tagged16 source. Genuine Core public NgZone/EventEmitter/ElementRef and CDK coercion execute both whole manual classes across ten original/minimum, zoneful/currentzoneless and dev/production contexts. Registration stays outside Angular; child transition targets, indeterminate/query modes and absent observers do not re-enter or emit; determinate/buffer events re-enter once with the current value; destruction removes the listener and prevents further callbacks. Each mode is asserted separately after an aggregate-only draft test failed to reject a mode swap. The final producer rejects66 runtime and12 source faults, and checks the two consumed public methods are nondeprecated at each peer. Decorators are omitted, event target registration semantics are explicit protocols, and RxJS is borrowed. This closes the dependency import boundary only: native CSS transitions, node DI, AOT/packed, full Node/Rx/compiler floors and the remaining component/upstream/audit gates are not qualified. No product/API/resources or required Cyph HTML/CSS/SCSS changes.
